note: 界面与术语英文词条；未收录的长句（多为法规条目正文）在英文模式下保留中文原文并标注语言，不虚构官方英文版本。

entries.本模型已覆盖法定项目汇总: Sum of statutory items covered by this model
entries.这个判断怎么来的（资料成熟度与覆盖能力）: How this conclusion was reached (evidence maturity and coverage)
entries.由平台补充官方依据: Official evidence to be added by the platform
entries.还没有选完目的地与品类。完成第 1 步后，这里会显示当前能做到哪一步以及缺少什么: Destination and product are not selected yet. After step 1, this area shows what you can do now and what is missing.
entries.关键输入已齐，可生成报告。: All key inputs are complete; a report can be generated.
entries.HS 候选（如该组合有候选）: HS candidate (if available for this combination)
entries.gap.user_input: Required fields have not been filled in yet.
entries.gap.product_fact: The product facts on record are not enough to complete this check.
entries.gap.hs_review: More than one classification direction is possible; the branch has not been confirmed.
entries.gap.regulation_data: The market has regulation entries but no executable clause rules for this product.
entries.gap.tax_profile_missing: No verified duty profile exists for this product and market combination.
entries.gap.scenario_unsupported: This import or pricing route is not implemented in the calculation engine.
entries.gap.date_out_of_range: No rule or rate configuration covers the selected date.
entries.gap.evidence_pending: Official verification is incomplete, so results stay conservative.
entries.need.user_input: Fill in the listed fields to continue.
entries.need.product_fact: Confirm the technical features that affect the decision (power supply, function, materials).
entries.need.hs_review: Answer the distinguishing questions and select one HS candidate direction.
entries.need.regulation_data: Clause-level rules and official references for this product still need to be added.
entries.need.tax_profile_missing: Tariff line, rate basis and applicable conditions must be verified against the official schedule.
entries.need.scenario_unsupported: Route-specific valuation or duty rules must be added.
entries.need.date_out_of_range: A configuration covering the selected import or placing-on-market date is required.
entries.need.evidence_pending: Complete the professional review and confirm the outstanding conditions.
entries.M 反映产品资料成熟度，与目的地无关；切换目的地只改变 L 等级。: M reflects how complete the product evidence is and does not depend on the destination; switching destination only changes L.
entries.L 表示该产品出口到该市场可用的功能范围；L3 不代表任何交易条件都能直接算出金: L indicates which functions are available for this product in this market; L3 does not mean any transaction condition yields an amount.
entries.等级与状态由实际数据和统一的能力判断生成，不针对具体产品硬编码。: Levels and statuses are derived from actual data through one shared capability check, not hard-coded per product.
entries.按目的地、产品大类、产品组与小类筛选，查看税率查询、税额测算与已覆盖项目汇总的实: Filter by destination, category, group and subcategory to see the real status of tariff lookup, duty calculation and covered-item subtotal.
entries.该组合尚无经核验的税费画像。: This combination has no verified duty profile yet.
entries.税率可查，但缺少交易条件，税额未计算。: Tariff rate is available, but duty is not calculated because transaction details are missing.
entries.已按当前条件计算分项，完整汇总需确认剩余条件。: Line items calculated from current inputs; the full subtotal still requires the remaining conditions to be confirmed.
entries.导入日期不在现有配置的适用区间内。: The import date falls outside the effective range of the current configuration.
entries.查找法规原文与配套资料: Find regulation texts and supporting material
entries.按国家、政策主题、适用产品和文件类型筛选；每份资料都保留官方来源，方便核对现行要: Filter by country, policy topic, applicable products and file type. Every item keeps its official source so you can check the requirement in force.
entries.搜索文件名称、法规编号或关键词，例如：CPSR、GST、8508: Search file name, regulation number or keyword, e.g. CPSR, GST, 8508
entries.只看已归类到主题与适用产品的资料: Show only items already classified by topic and product
entries.同一文件的其他来源编号: Other source IDs for the same file
entries.网页阅读版（非官方原文 PDF）: Web reading version (not the official PDF text)
entries.找到 {n} 份资料（库内 {m} 条记录，同一文件的不同来源已合并显示）: Found {n} files ({m} records in the library; different sources of the same file are merged)
entries.来源：政府及监管机构公开公告。: Sources: Official government and regulatory announcements.
entries.查看产品型号、技术参数及公开资料，并可带入当前项目。: Browse models, technical parameters and public sources, and bring them into the current project.
entries.技术参数不会自动带入，需要你按出口版本确认: Technical parameters are not carried over automatically; confirm them against the export version
entries.这个工作台帮你做什么: What this workspace does for you
entries.密钥仅保存在本机浏览器，不会写入仓库或导出文件。: The key is stored only in this browser and is never written to the repository or exported files.
entries.每条结论可回到来源与输入: Every conclusion traces back to its source and inputs
entries.部分法规条目仅有中文说明。: Some regulation entries are documented in Chinese only.
entries.切换语言不改变项目数据与计算结果。: Switching language does not change project data or calculation results.
entries.进口 GST: Goods and Services Tax (GST) on import
entries.该组合暂无目的国候选（缺口）: No destination tariff candidate for this combination (gap)
entries.先选好「产品 × 目的地」，系统只追问影响当前判断的关键事实；案例与研究资料可一: Pick the product and destination first. The system only asks for the facts that change the current conclusion; case files and research can be brought in with one click.
entries.从企业案例带入: Bring in from a company case
entries.案例档案来自公开官网与披露文件：国内在售型号不能自动当作出口型号；研究路线不等于: Case files come from public websites and disclosures: a model sold domestically is not automatically the export model, and a research roadmap is not a completed export fact.
entries.选择上方产品组后显示品类卡片。: Choose a product group above to show category cards.
entries.交易要素（货值、运保、币种、贸易术语、措施核查）: Transaction inputs (goods value, freight and insurance, currency, Incoterms, measures check)
entries.勾选的政策新闻与研究档案: Selected policy news and research files
entries.缺关键条件时分项留空，不按 0 计: Line items stay empty when key conditions are missing; never treated as zero
entries.无法初筛，页面提示先完成登记: Screening is blocked and the page asks you to complete registration first
entries.不勾选则不进入任务；旧建议按输入指纹标记需重新分析: Unselected items are not included; older advice is flagged for re-analysis by input version
entries.适用哪些合规规则、需要办什么、HS 候选方向: Which compliance rules apply, what to do, and HS candidate directions
entries.加载哪套法规、按哪个版本判断: Which set of regulations is loaded and which version applies
entries.税基、税率、税额与已覆盖项目汇总: Tax base, rates, amounts and the covered-item subtotal
entries.千问任务的证据范围、报告内容: Evidence scope of the AI task and report content
entries.相关判断显示「待补事实」，不会按「否」处理: Affected checks show "facts to confirm" instead of being treated as "no"
entries.研究解释 · 候选归类方向 · 待补项: Research note · candidate classification · items to complete
entries.本次未取得逐型号税单: No per-model duty statements were obtained
entries.小家电出海合规工作台: Small home appliance export compliance workspace
entries.从了解产品，到准备出海: From understanding the product to preparing for export
entries.都有清晰的出海准备路径。: Every product has a clear export preparation path.
entries.投放市场 / 首次供应日期: Date placed on market / first supply
entries.选填参数（不影响当前结论）: Optional parameters (do not change the current conclusion)
entries.hashed_local_copy_live_access_unresolved: Archived copy verified by hash; live access not re-resolved
entries.live_url_and_hashed_local_copy: Live URL reachable and archived copy hash verified
entries.browser_verified_probe_false_negative: Verified in browser; automated probe gave a false negative
